title: [Backport 29.x] Batch SCM extensibility requests
summary: Backports six SCM extensibility requests to releases/29.x, one commit per reference. Touches Quality Management generation rules and result evaluation, Purchase Line, Customer and Requisition Line across several localization layers. Customer gains an enum-based event publisher while the option-based one is kept under CLEAN30 handling.
key_points: Six extensibility requests backported to releases/29.x with one dedicated commit each
Quality Management generation rule table and result evaluation codeunit modified
Purchase Line and Customer updated in W1 and many, but not all, localization layers
Customer adds an enum-based event publisher, keeping the option-based one under CLEAN30
Requisition Line updated in W1 and IT layers
